thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: We can solve this problem using a greedy approach. The idea is to keep track of the possible lower and upper bound of valid open parentheses count as we traverse the string. For every '(', we increment both lower and upper bounds, for every ')', we decrement both bounds, and for '*', we increment the lower bound and decrement the upper bound. At each step, we ensure that the lower bound never goes below 0.
